paragraphs: He spoke to Ravina. Hyman records this report in Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot and says that it is not found anywhere.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman records a statement to Ravina in Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot and then says that he has not found it elsewhere. That bibliographic observation is Hyman’s, not the content of Mar Zutra’s speech to Ravina.

The saved Sefaria Export Seder HaDorot merged text contains the whole one-paragraph entry “מר זוטרא בר אבדימי לרבינא:”. It supports the named address to Ravina; it does not independently verify Yuchasin or a claim of absence elsewhere. The prior whole-entry exclusion from cohort102 remains historically true. Hyman’s bibliographic report and universal negative observation remain his own, separate from the speech to Ravina; no identity binding is added.
